The decisive mistake was made by the **Orchestrator (thought)** at step 21.

At step 16, the search results included Fubo's official governance page (ir.fubo.tv/governance, "Management Team"), which was the most direct source for the management team and their roles. Step 20 was the first LinkedIn visit, and it returned a non-management profile. The Orchestrator then declared a loop at step 21 even though only one LinkedIn visit had occurred, so nothing was actually repeating. It routed the task to the Assistant, which has no browser access, and never sent WebSurfer back to the governance page. The remaining steps produced only planning text, failed geo-blocked attempts, and a timeout with "Unable to determine."

The Assistant's step 24 was unproductive, but it was following a misdirected assignment that the Orchestrator made at step 21.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 21
